name: eMACS J0045.2-0151 (Hubble)
blurb: eMACS J0045.2-0151, a massive galaxy cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: emacsj004520151-hubble
story: An extremely massive cluster of galaxies, picked out in an X-ray survey. Its gravity can act as a natural lens, and Hubble searches clusters like this for the most powerful lenses and for faint, far more distant galaxies behind them.

claims.text: eMACS J0045.2-0151 is a target of program 14098, a snapshot survey of the most massive galaxy clusters from the X-ray selected eMACS sample
The program aims to identify the most powerful gravitational lenses and to find distant Balmer-break and Lyman-break galaxies
